canonical_statement: For arbitrary real scalar flux f, left and right states uL and uR, and interface speed s, the weak defect of the two constant states across x = s*t vanishes against every smooth compactly supported spacetime test function if and only if s*(uR-uL) = f(uR)-f(uL).
domain_and_universes: f : Real -> Real; uL uR s : Real; phi : Real x Real -> Real; Prop in universe 0; Lebesgue integration along the interface parameter t
ordered_binders: phi : Real x Real -> Real (inside InterfaceDefectVanishes)
conclusion: InterfaceDefectVanishes f uL uR s iff s * (uR - uL) = f uR - f uL

encoding_decisions.interface: the straight line x = s*t, parameterized by t : Real
encoding_decisions.interface_defect: (f uR - f uL - s*(uR-uL)) times the Lebesgue integral of phi(t,s*t)
encoding_decisions.test_functions: all ContDiff Real top compactly supported functions on Real x Real
encoding_decisions.flux_regularity: none is needed after the constant-state weak defect has been reduced to the two endpoint values f uL and f uR
encoding_decisions.interface_representative: only the trace phi(t,s*t) occurs; no value of the discontinuous state on the interface is selected
